name: Pasupati Fincap Limited
about: Pasupati Fincap Limited, manufactures and sells textiles and fibers products in India and internationally. It offers yarns and fibers, such as polyester, viscose, silk, rayon, and blends and processes, finishes, dye and bleach fabrics. In addition, the company also provides home textiles products, such as carpets, upholstery, linens and related goods; manufactures and supply healthcare products, including surgical cotton, bandages, sanitary products, and allied items. Further, it designs and sells plastic molded components and sheet metal parts for appliances, automotive systems, speakers and industrial applications. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Ghaziabad, India.
